name: Nozawaonsen (Japan)
description: A light blue field charged at the centre with the Nozawaonsen village emblem in white: a ring enclosing a stylised mountain peak.
history: Municipal flag of Nozawaonsen, a village in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 29 May 1964.

features.role: Nozawaonsen village emblem — a ring enclosing a stylised mountain peak
